intro: Podrig's Order is a written military requisition penned by Deathguard Podrig at the Sepulcher. It requests a fresh shipment of weapons from Undercity merchant Gordon Wendham to keep Silverpine's Forsaken garrison properly armed.

p: Silverpine Forest is a precarious frontier for the Forsaken, caught between encroaching Scourge, feral beasts, and other lurking threats. After an equipment inventory conducted by Deathguard Podrig on the orders of Executor Hadrec, the Sepulcher's stores were found mostly adequate but desperately low on replacement weapons. This official dispatch details the needed blades and arms to sustain the Deathguards holding the outpost.

Because weapons cannot be forged easily amidst the damp crypts of Silverpine, the request is directed to Gordon Wendham, a weapon dealer located in the bustling Trade Quarter of the Undercity. To expedite the order, couriers carry the document directly to bat master Karos Razok, taking advantage of Forsaken flight paths to secure a swift resupply from the capital.
